title: Reference Library Keeper
subtitle: Keeps each document collection fresh on its own schedule by re-reading only files that changed, re-summarising and re-indexing them, and retrying any sections whose summary failed.
lede: Keeps each document collection fresh on its own schedule by re-reading only files that changed, re-summarising and re-indexing them, and retrying any sections whose summary failed. It also gives a per-document quality summary and reprocesses failed documents on request.
who: A knowledge manager who looks after a folder of manuals, specifications and internal guides
author: Corey James
